item.title: Election Filing
item.description: There is still time to file as a candidate in the April Municipal Election. Filing continues through December 30th. Another filing was received for the Central Dispatch Board. Matt Gabrielson filed for the at-large position that includes a four-year term. That filing for that board takes place at the Livingston County Clerk’s office.

item.description: A portion of US 65 in Grundy County was closed for several hours Monday night. The Grundy County Sheriff reported the road closed at US 65 and NE 80th Street at about 5:10 pm following a crash involving a “super Move” of a large windmill blade. item.title: Two New Buses Delivered To Chillicothe R-II Schools
item.description: The Chillicothe R-II School District took delivery of two new buses on Monday. School officials say the new buses will soon replace two of the oldest buses in its fleet. They said the upgrade of the bus fleet shows the district’s commitment to the safe transportation of 1,200+ students every day.
